request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:GUARD

layers.text: Change four things only. The big biscuit shield becomes a thick slab of dark chocolate #4a2412 bar marked into square blocks. The pink frosting on its top becomes golden caramel #e0a040 dripping down its sides. Its pink arms and legs become golden caramel, and its feet dark chocolate #4a2412. The pink dots on its body become cream. No pink is left except its two cheeks. Keep the white marshmallow body, the face, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
